member.name: CallerInfoSummary
member.summary: Captures caller‑site metadata (member name, source file path, and line number) using compiler‑supplied Caller Info attributes. This pattern allows a routine to record the exact call site without requiring the caller to provide this information explicitly. It is useful for diagnostics, logging, tracing, and any scenario where precise call‑site provenance enhances maintainability or debugging.

member.name: CallerInfoParameters
member.param: The name of the calling method or property. Automatically supplied by the compiler when decorated with .
The full path of the source file that contains the calling member. Automatically supplied by the compiler when decorated with .
The line number in the source file at which this routine was invoked. Automatically supplied by the compiler when decorated with .
